inlines.v: SPRINKLING, participle present tense 1. Dispersing, as a liquid or as dust. 2. Scattering on, in fine drops or particles. SPRINKLING, noun 1. The act of scattering in small drops or parcels. 2. A small quantity falling in distinct drops or parts, or coming moderately; as a sprinkling of rain or snow.
